sys_hub_action_instance_v2.comment: Gets one page of projects from Xero (up to 500)
Checks if this Xero project already exists in SPM.
Looks for an existing US project (Company = Konversational America) with the same name.
Connects it to the Xero project and flags it as legacy.
Checks again if the project exists in SPM.
Creates or updates the client company from the Xero contact (saved in Customer Account).
Checks that the agreed rate model exists. A new rate model is never created.
Xero contact has no Customer Account in SPM: warn the PM only when the project is new. The project and its tasks are still created.
Tells the PM, on the project, that the customer account does not exist.
Links the agreed rate model to the project.
Fires the e-mail with all RATE MODEL, RESOURCE ROLE and CUSTOMER ACCOUNT problems of this project.
Logs “Xero sync failed for project” with the project name.

sys_hub_sub_flow_instance_v2.comment: Connects its tasks to Xero by name. No other data is changed.
Creates or updates the project tasks. Tasks without a matching resource role or rate line are skipped and returned in task_problems.

sys_hub_flow_logic_instance_v2.comment: Stops if Xero could not be reached.
Runs all the steps of one project; an error goes to the Catch and the loop continues.
In "only new" mode, skips projects that already exist in SPM.
If it does not exist in SPM yet:

sys_hub_action_instance_v2.comment: Gets one page of projects from Xero (up to 500)
Checks if this Xero project already exists in SPM.
Connects it to the Xero project and flags it as legacy.
Checks again if the project exists in SPM.
Creates or updates the client company from the Xero contact (saved in Customer Account).
Looks for an existing US project (Company = Konversational America) with the same name.
Xero contact has no Customer Account in SPM: warn the PM only when the project is new. The project and its tasks are still created.
Links the agreed rate model to the project.
Logs “Xero sync failed for project” with the project name.
Tells the PM, on the project, that the customer account does not exist.
Fires the e-mail with all RATE MODEL, RESOURCE ROLE and CUSTOMER ACCOUNT problems of this project.
Checks that the agreed rate model exists. A new rate model is never created.

sys_hub_sub_flow_instance_v2.comment: Connects its tasks to Xero by name. No other data is changed.
Creates or updates the project tasks. Tasks without a matching resource role or rate line are skipped and returned in task_problems.

sys_hub_flow_logic_instance_v2.comment: Runs all the steps of one project; an error goes to the Catch and the loop continues.
In "only new" mode, skips projects that already exist in SPM.
Goes to the next Xero project.
If it does not exist in SPM yet:
If one is found:
If it is a legacy project:
Keeps the current Customer Account of the project. Resets the problem list and the account flags for this project.
Calls Xero for the contact only when the project is new, has no Customer Account, or its contact changed in Xero.
Only overwrites the Customer Account when the contact has an account in SPM.
Uses the account returned by the Xero contact sync.
Remembers whether the Xero contact has no account in SPM, to warn the PM after the project is saved.
Portfolio by project name: "Managed Services" in the name uses US Managed Services, otherwise US Projects. Always recalculated.
Xero contact has no Customer Account in SPM: warn the PM. The project and tasks are not blocked.
Adds a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT line to the e-mail.
Counts only the projects created in this run.
Adds 1 to the created projects.
Reads the agreed rate model (sys_id) from the system property.
Tasks are only created when the agreed rate model exists.
Runs when the agreed rate model was not found.
Adds a RATE MODEL line to the e-mail. No task is created for this project.
Sends one e-mail per project when there is anything to fix.
Error in this project: logs it and continues with the next project.
Adds 1 to the projects that failed in this page.
Adds skipped tasks to the e-mail and keeps the tasks created for this project.
Adds the tasks created for this project to the total.
Otherwise (new or regular project):
Keeps the page count returned by Xero - Get Projects.
Returns the page count to the parent (0 if Xero failed). Also returns the counters of this page.
Uses the page received from the parent. Page count stays 0 if Xero fails, Resets the counters of this page.
Stops if Xero could not be reached.
Repeats the steps below for each Xero project.
